# Clepso 0.4.0 alpha 1 — within reach
This alpha adds desktop widgets, a read-only MCP server and signed in-app updates. Existing Claude/Codex readers, menu-bar rotation, Goals controls, stepped toggles, compact Account layout and native model characters remain available.
- **Widgets:** small and medium WidgetKit layouts. Enable sharing in Settings → Integrations, then add Clepso limits from the Mac widget gallery. Missing, manual, old and expected-reset readings stay explicitly labeled. - **MCP:** allow a named client in Settings → Integrations, review its disclosure and copy the setup. Two read-only tools expose limits and reader health; no prompts, paths, credentials, session IDs or shell access. Revoke access without restarting a client. Your client may forward usage readings to its AI provider. - **Updates:** Sparkle 2.10.0 with signed feeds and archives, verification before extraction and no system-profile reporting. Manual check, daily checks and automatic installation are in Settings. Automatic choices start off. Earlier updater-free releases still need this first upgrade by DMG/Homebrew. - **Models:** a restrained native pixel flourish marks a newly reached output level while viewing the same model. Opening a model, changing range, demo mode, replayed older readings and inactive views do not trigger it. Pause and Reduce Motion stop the moving effect. - **Publisher:** privacy contact is Elvis Obi, Lagos, Nigeria, contact@elvisobi.com. No new domain was purchased.
Sharing is optional and local. The widget is a separate sandboxed extension, using only an allowlisted aggregate snapshot. MCP uses a private file and local stdio, with no HTTP listener. Deleting local data revokes sharing and clears the widget snapshot. No existing tracking connection is disabled by this update.
This is an incremental alpha, not a claim that every roadmap item is live. Automatic adapters for the other providers, iPhone/Watch/relay/push, live Apple/Google/GitHub OAuth, additional edition costumes and remaining physical QA continue separately. The publisher confirmed that OAuth applications have not yet been registered. Domain purchase remains explicitly excluded. A legal engineering review is not an external legal sign-off.
Computer use still fails to attach, so fresh widget-gallery, VoiceOver and physical focus/lifecycle checks remain unverified. The committed QA report records automated and build/signing evidence separately.
